methodologyNotes: Adversarially re-verified 2026-06-18 via WebFetch on official pricing pages plus WebSearch corroboration. KEY FINDINGS: (1) DataFeedWatch's official pricing page does NOT publish monthly USD prices — they are gated behind a 15-day trial signup; the $64/$84/$239/$599 figures are corroborated only via aggregators (stackdex.io mirror, adnabu, business.digital) and 2+ independent sources, NOT the official page. Agency price conflicts between sources ($239 corroborated by majority vs $196 in one review). (2) WakeupData's connect.wakeupdata.com calculator shows $0/no fixed prices; the $79/$99 tiers appear only on the Shopify App Store listing, now used as the authoritative source. (3) GoDataFeed marketplace overage corrected to $49/inventory-feed + $99/catalog-feed. (4) Feedoptimise's official pricing page does NOT advertise free Google CSS — claim removed. Channable ($49/$64/$74 + $35 add-ons) confirmed via search/help center after official page returned 429. Feedonomics and Productsup confirmed quote-only on official pages (monthlyUsd null). Feedoptimise's 11 tiers ($59-$431) confirmed exactly on the official page. Prices are USD self-serve monthly base rates; telephony fields null (N/A). accessedAt 2026-06-18.
